sources.author: rubberduck
sources.changes: Selected three wet-footstep variations (sfx100v2_footstep_wet_01–03.ogg); converted from stereo 48 kHz Vorbis to mono 48 kHz Opus in Ogg containers without loudness normalization; sfx100v2_misc_36.ogg kept byte-identical as received and renamed player-block-full-01.ogg; unused source effects excluded
sources.title: 100 CC0 SFX #2

sources.author: Jordan Irwin (AntumDeluge)
sources.changes: Converted the selected PCM WAV; trimmed leading silence, faded the tail, converted to 24 kHz mono Opus in Ogg, and applied loudness normalization plus true-peak limiting (final measured LUFS and true peak are in the d13b report).
sources.title: Thwack Sounds

sources.author: rubberduck
sources.changes: Selected two wooden item-drop clips, a pouch-handling clip, and a placeholder fist hit; trimmed leading silence, faded tails, converted to 24 kHz mono Opus in Ogg, and applied loudness normalization plus true-peak limiting (final measured LUFS and true peak are in the d13b report). The fist-hit placeholder is wired to the live and restored melee-action path when the fists profile is active.
sources.title: 75 CC0 Breaking/Falling/Hit SFX
